jobs.title: Senior Software Engineers (ADA 95)
jobs.description:
Overview:
Expleo is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to support the development, sustainment, integration and deployment of advanced test \& simulation systems operating within secure and regulated environments.

The role covers the full software development lifecycle, including defect investigation, software design and modification, integration, verification, regression testing, release preparation and deployment support.

The successful candidate will work with existing, long\-life software baselines and contribute to the delivery of approved changes, defect resolutions and system enhancements.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, the Senior Software Engineer will provide technical leadership for complex software investigations, support engineering reviews and help ensure that software outputs are technically complete, traceable and appropriately controlled.

The position provides the opportunity to work on complex, mission\-critical systems that support operational training and simulation capabilities.

The role is primarily site\-based within a secure engineering environment and may involve occasional travel to authorised locations for integration, testing and deployment activities.
Responsibilities:
* Develop, modify and maintain software applications supporting test \& simulation systems.
* Lead or undertake software defect investigation, root\-cause analysis and fault resolution.
* Analyse change requirements and produce engineering assessments, effort estimates and technical recommendations.
* Design and implement approved software changes and system enhancements.
* Undertake code reviews and provide constructive technical challenge.
* Support software integration across hardware interfaces, networks, operating systems and external systems.
* Plan and undertake unit, integration, regression and defect\-verification testing.
* Generate objective test evidence and produce clear, auditable test reports.
* Maintain traceability between defects, approved changes, source\-code updates, test evidence and release artefacts.
* Apply configuration\-management and version\-control processes to software and supporting documentation.
* Generate controlled software builds and prepare release candidates.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, including design information, configuration records, test evidence and release documentation.
* Support release reviews, deployment preparation and authorised deployment activities.
* Investigate and resolve complex issues affecting operational or representative test environments.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical reviews, peer reviews, retrospectives and backlog\-refinement activities.
* Provide accurate progress reporting, including deliverable status, risks, issues, dependencies and planned activities.
* Identify and escalate technical risks and issues through the appropriate engineering routes.
* Support transition and knowledge\-transfer activities where required.
* Work collaboratively with software, systems, integration, test, assurance and support teams.
* Comply with applicable quality, safety, security, software\-development and engineering\-governance requirements.


Qualifications:
* Degree, HNC, HND or equivalent qualification in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related STEM discipline.
* Equivalent practical software\-engineering experience will also be considered where supported by relevant technical expertise and evidence of delivery.
* Evidence of continued professional development in software engineering, systems integration, verification, configuration management or a related discipline is desirable.
* Professional registration or progress towards professional registration is desirable but not essential.


Essential skills:
* Strong software design, development, debugging and maintenance skills.
* Demonstrable software\-development experience using **Ada 95**.
* Software\-development experience using **C\+\+ and/or C\#**.
* Ability to understand, modify and review existing and long\-life software baselines.
* Structured software defect investigation and root\-cause analysis.
* Code\-review and peer\-review skills.
* Unit, integration and regression testing.
* Verification of software fixes and production of objective test evidence.
* Software configuration management and controlled change management.
* Version\-control experience using Git, Subversion or an equivalent repository tool.
* Software\-build generation and release\-candidate preparation.
* Ability to maintain traceability across requirements, defects, changes, source code, tests and releases.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Linux operating environments.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation, engineering assessments and test reports.
* Ability to estimate software\-engineering activities and communicate assumptions, dependencies and technical risks.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability.
* Clear written and verbal technical communication.
* Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
* Ability to work within formal engineering\-governance, configuration\-control and security processes.
* Ability to deliver work through sprint\-based or iterative engineering processes.


Experience:
* Significant experience delivering software engineering within a commercial, defence, aerospace, maritime or other regulated engineering environment.
* Experience developing, maintaining or supporting software using Ada 95\.
* Experience developing or maintaining software using C\+\+ and/or C\#.
* Experience maintaining and enhancing operational, deployed or long\-life software systems.
* Experience working with mixed\-language software baselines.
* Experience investigating and resolving complex software defects.
* Experience undertaking structured root\-cause analysis.
* Experience designing and implementing approved software changes.
* Experience working under formal change\-control and configuration\-management arrangements.
* Experience conducting code reviews and technical peer reviews.
* Experience with unit, integration, regression and defect\-verification testing.
* Experience generating objective test evidence and formal test reports.
* Experience producing controlled software builds and supporting release activities.
* Experience preparing release notes, deployment information or other release artefacts.
* Experience integrating software with hardware interfaces, operating systems, networks or external systems.
* Experience producing and maintaining controlled technical documentation.
* Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team.
* Experience communicating technical findings, estimates, risks and recommendations to engineering stakeholders.
* Experience working within sprint\-based or iterative delivery environments.
* Experience supporting software deployment and post\-deployment regression testing.
* Experience operating within secure facilities or controlled engineering environments.
* Experience of test \& simulation systems is desirable.
* Experience of defence, maritime, training or synthetic\-environment systems is desirable.
* Experience using Jira or an equivalent backlog and defect\-management tool is desirable.
* Experience using Teamcenter or an equivalent product\-lifecycle or workflow\-management tool is desirable.
* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory\-integrated environments is desirable.
* Experience diagnosing IP networking, multihomed computer or basic network\-switch configuration issues is desirable.
* Experience using PXE or an equivalent network deployment method is desirable.
* Experience using Symantec Ghost or equivalent system\-imaging and recovery tools is desirable.
* Experience supporting infrastructure upgrades and deployed computing environments is desirable.
* Experience working with technical authorities, design authorities or assurance teams is desirable.
* Experience troubleshooting software deployed across networked computer systems.


What do I need before I apply:
* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain **UK Security Clearance (SC)**.
* Willingness to work within secure defence facilities and controlled environments.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  

DailyPay is the leader in On\-Demand Pay, helping employers modernize how people get their pay. DailyPay serves more than 1,900 employers and over 6 million employees, including many of the world's most recognized brands. By providing real\-time access to earned pay and financial wellness tools, DailyPay helps employees manage their finances and helps employers attract and retain talent. DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work.. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center.

**The Role**
------------


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work alongside a supportive, high\-impact team of skilled developers to improve how our teams deploy and access services, how data moves across our platform, and how we automate operations to enable future scale. Our teams specialize in developing robust and scalable Go microservices, leveraging a modern tech stack that includes AWS, Docker, Postgres, and Kafka. We are looking for engineers passionate about building high\-quality solutions who thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
-------------------------------

* **Build Scalable Services:** Design, develop, and maintain robust backend services and APIs that support our evolving platform.
* **Drive Architectural Evolution:** Contribute directly to the transition to microservices by designing clean APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* **Optimize Data Performance:** Enhance database performance and data structures to support high\-traffic, real\-time applications and seamless data movement.
* **Collaborate Cross\-Functionally:** Partner with various teams to ensure technical solutions are perfectly aligned with business requirements and user needs.
* **Champion Engineering Excellence:** Mentor fellow engineers and perform thorough code reviews to drive best practices in Golang.
* **Automate for Scale:** Identify opportunities to automate operations, making it easier for other teams to deploy and access their services efficiently.
* **Solve High\-Traffic Challenges:** Apply pragmatic engineering to handle the complexities of moving data across a distributed platform at scale.

**What You Bring to the Team**
------------------------------

* **Strong Technical Foundation:** 4\+ years of hands\-on software development experience, including at least 2 years working with strongly\-typed languages (Go, Java, C\#, etc.).
* **Microservices Expertise:** Demonstrated experience designing and developing microservices within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* **Code Quality:** A proven ability to write maintainable, high\-quality, and robust code with a pragmatic approach to problem\-solving.
* **Data \& Messaging Proficiency:** Experience working with SQL databases and a solid knowledge of message queues (Kafka, SQS) and asynchronous processing patterns.
* **Effective Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to describe technical designs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Infrastructure \& Methodology:** Familiarity with cloud\-based infrastructure, basic networking, and Agile/Kanban methodologies.

  

**What We Offer:**
------------------

* Competitive compensation
* Opportunity for equity ownership
* Private health insurance option
* Employee Resource Groups
* Fun company outings and events
* Generous PTO Allowance
* 5% Pension contribution

  

\#BI\-Remote \#LI\-Remote

  

High\-performing cultures aren't built in silos, they thrive on partnership. At DailyPay, we **Commit Together** to an inclusive, professional environment where multifaceted perspectives are our greatest competitive advantage. We recognize that our team members don’t live “single\-issue lives,” and we lean into the wide\-ranging backgrounds and life stages that sharpen our collective decision\-making.


In our high\-trust environment, we empower you to **Challenge Norms**. We’ve created a space where it is safe to ask difficult questions, disrupt the status quo, and share bold perspectives without fear of professional fallout. We believe that by checking our own assumptions and staying curious about the experiences of others, we arrive at better, more innovative results.


We provide the space for you to do your best work through peer advocacy and transparent career development. If you are looking for a culture that values intellectual honesty, celebrates the unique lived experiences of its people, and thrives on collective success, you’ll find it here.


If you require reasonable accommodation for any aspect of the recruitment process, please send a request to peopleops@dailypay.com. All requests for accommodation will be addressed as confidentially as practicable.


DailyPay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws.

They design and develop high\-quality, scalable, and innovative software solutions in a SaaS environment, utilizing cutting\-edge technologies and methodologies, and ensuring they meet the current and future needs of the business and its customers.


### **What You'll Do**

* **Stakeholder Engagement**: Works with stakeholders, including product managers, designers, developers, and executives, to align architectural designs with business needs and customer expectations.

jobs.title: Platform Product Owner
jobs.description:
AppyWay is the industry\-leading SaaS solution decarbonising cities by empowering local authorities to digitally manage their kerbside and share kerbside data with fleets and drivers.


Our journey began with AppyParking, an app born from the frustration of finding and understanding parking on the streets of London. During the app’s creation, it was clear that cities lacked shareable, machine\-readable, standardised parking restriction data. So we built the UK’s largest set of standardised kerbside data, in turn discovering the untapped potential beneath everyone’s feet.


Today, we’re Europe’s leading intelligent kerbside platform, helping cities and drivers optimise operations and transition to net zero by uniting parking/loading maps, occupancy data, and cashless payments.


Our impressive client roster includes local authorities such as Edinburgh, Southwark, Lambeth, Haringey, Harrogate, Cambridgeshire, Cornwall, Dorset, Dublin and, more recently across the pond, New York City. Additionally, our apps and API are trusted by tens of thousands of drivers and fleets including Blue Badge innovators Motability Operations.


We are proud to have the support of top investors, including Hyundai Motor Company, Aviva Ventures, Mastercard and Esri. To date, we have raised over £20 million in funding, allowing us to continue building something big from the ground up.


If you’re passionate about tangible solutions to help decarbonise the world, then AppyWay is the perfect place for you. Come and make your mark on a company you can call your own!


About the role
We’re looking for a **Platform Product Owner to own our Kerbside Intelligence Platform, also known internally as “The Hub.”**


The Hub is a foundational part of AppyWay’s product strategy. It will become the canonical platform for our parking and kerbside intelligence, bringing together data from multiple sources into a consistent, trusted and reusable model.


The Hub vision and strategic direction are set. You’ll own day\-to\-day product delivery — translating that strategy into a clear and prioritised backlog, partnering closely with Engineering and Data to execute it, and ensuring consuming products have the platform capabilities they need to move forward.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of product, technology and data, and who can turn complex platform problems into clear, incremental pieces of work that deliver value.

 **Requirements**  

  

What you will be doing* + Execute the product roadmap, backlog and priorities for the Hub Platform.
	+ Work closely with Engineering to implement the kerbside data model, ensuring it meets consuming product requirements and that concepts such as parking assets, geometry, restrictions, tariffs, rights, entitlements and operating rules are represented consistently.
	+ Work with the Data team to define requirements for data classification and standardisation, ensuring data from multiple sources is transformed into consistent, machine\-readable information and meets agreed quality standards.
	+ Own product requirements for data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation and publication.
	+ Work closely with Engineering and Data to define and deliver scalable platform capabilities and APIs that can be reused across multiple products and customers.
	+ Drive the development and scaling of platform APIs, defining contracts, capabilities, consumption patterns and priorities for internal and external use cases.
	+ Identify opportunities to leverage AI and machine learning to improve data classification, anomaly detection, validation, conflict resolution and other data\-intensive workflows.
	+ Work with Data Operations to move towards an exception\-based operating model, where automation handles high\-confidence cases and people focus on complex decisions and edge cases.
	+ Work across Product, Engineering, Data, GIS, Commercial and Operations to understand requirements, manage dependencies and ensure the platform solves real business and customer problems.
	+ Maintain a clear and prioritised product backlog, balancing foundational platform development with the needs of consuming products.
	+ Define clear acceptance criteria, quality standards and success measures for platform capabilities.
	+ Manage dependencies across technical teams and ensure platform changes are clearly communicated, understood and adopted by consuming teams.
	+ Continuously identify opportunities for the platform to remove duplication, reduce manual effort, improve data quality and enable AppyWay to scale its coverage and product offering.


Essential* + 6\+ years’ experience owning technical, platform or data products in an agile environment, with a proven ability to work closely with Engineering teams on complex, data\-heavy systems.
	+ Essential: proven experience with a geospatial product, geospatial data platform or complex SaaS data platform.
	+ A proven track record of owning technical products or platforms, with a good working understanding of APIs, data models, data pipelines and microservices.
	+ Experience designing or managing data pipelines, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation and distribution.
	+ Experience with data classification, standardisation and data quality, particularly where multiple data sources need to be brought together into a consistent model.
	+ Experience working with and scaling APIs and platform capabilities that are consumed by multiple products, customers or third parties.
	+ Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, data models and modern cloud architectures, with the ability to work confidently with engineers and architects.
	+ Demonstrable experience identifying and applying AI capabilities to improve product functionality, automation, data quality or operational efficiency.
	+ Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, data practitioners, product teams and senior stakeholders.
	+ Comfort with ambiguity — you can break complex problems into clear scope, sequence work incrementally and make pragmatic product decisions without needing all the answers upfront.
	+ A strong analytical and structured approach to problem solving.
	+ Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams and keeping delivery focused on outcomes.
	+ Commercial awareness and an understanding of how shared platform capabilities can create leverage across a product portfolio.


Preferred* + Experience building geospatial data platforms or products involving maps, location intelligence or spatial data.
	+ Experience with GIS technologies, GeoJSON or spatial databases.
	+ Experience working with complex kerbside, parking, transport or mobility rules.
	+ Experience standardising fragmented datasets from multiple sources into a common canonical model.
	+ Experience with event\-driven data architectures and real\-time or near\-real\-time data processing.
	+ Experience applying AI/ML to geospatial or data\-quality problems, such as feature extraction, classification, anomaly detection or automated validation.
	+ Experience building developer\-facing products, APIs, SDKs or data services.
	+ Experience taking a platform from early\-stage architecture through to adoption across multiple products or teams.
	+ Experience working in SaaS, mobility, smart cities, transport or other location\-based technology environments.


Our tech stack
(This isn’t a shopping list — these are the technologies and patterns we use. We’d love to hear from people with some of these, or who are excited to pick them up and suggest alternatives.)

* C\# .NET
* Aurelia, TypeScript
* Azure infrastructure (App Services, Function Apps, Container Apps, etc.)
* DDD, CQRS, Event\-Driven Architecture
* SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Azure Storage
* Service Bus
* Elasticsearch
* Redis
* Git, Octopus Deploy
* Pulumi for IaC
* Microservices, SOA
* Power BI
* Time\-series data processing
* QGIS and related GIS/GeoJSON tools

  

**Benefits**  

* Enjoy a competitive salary of £60,000 depending on your profile and experience
* 25 days’ holiday plus all UK bank holidays and accrue additional holiday for each year you work with us up to 30 days total \- it’s our way of saying thank you!
* A hybrid flexible working model: Thursdays in our Covent Garden based office, and the option to work from home the rest of the week (if you that works for you), so that you don’t have to sacrifice your personal commitments
* ✈️ Want to stay a little longer at your dream destination? Have greater flexibility to ‘Work from Anywhere’ for up to a week at time
* Experience true ownership! Everyone at AppyWay owns a piece of the pie through our share option scheme, so when AppyWay does well, so do you!
* Save and plan for the future with our enhanced company pension scheme provided by Royal London. The more you contribute, the more we’ll contribute too!
* We’ll work to protect your compensation from a rapidly changing economy by carrying out an annual Cost of Living exercise to ensure your salary stays ahead of rising prices and interest rates
* Whilst we hope you never have to use it, we offer our entire team Death in Service insurance cover
* Your wellbeing matters to us, gain access to GP consultations, nutritionists, dental advice and counselling on demand
* Access hundreds of perks, discounts, weekly freebies, cashback offers and discounted gym memberships to help with the cost of living changes via PerkBox
* + Working on site? Enjoy a freshly made coffee from our onsite barista and a cold beverage at our bar at the end of the day!
* Everyone at AppyWay has their optimum setup, we’ll let you choose your own laptop, (PC or Mac) and accessories so you can work in comfort!
* Everyone at AppyWay has a clear growth framework and we’ll support you with the appropriate learning and development plan to achieve your goals
* Planning for or raising a family? You can expect to benefit from our inclusive leave options, nursing rooms and a dedicated plan to ensure you are fully supported on your return. You can also benefit from savings on nursery fees through our Workplace Nursery scheme
* We may work flexibly but we’re still a social bunch! Join one of our regular social events, group trips and activities throughout the year

* ️ A polite note to recruitment agencies: Our internal team handles 100% of our Talent Acquisition initiatives in\-house. We appreciate your interest, but external recruiters and agencies should not get in touch regarding this vacancy. Thank you!

jobs.title: Windows Software Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ORGANOX:**


OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543\) strives to fulfil its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

**Position Summary**

The Windows Software Manager is responsible for leading the design and development of software at OrganOx, for device\-hosted applications and services running on Windows\-based platforms, ensuring delivery of robust, high\-quality solutions for regulated medical environments. The role combines deep technical expertise developing Graphical User Interfaces (GUI), connectivity solutions and implementing cybersecurity mitigations, with strong leadership of teams, projects and cross\-functional stakeholders.


Operating with a system\-level perspective, the Windows Software Manager takes end\-to\-end ownership of the application software, driving alignment with quality standards and regulatory compliance requirements. The role also serves as a key technical representative for OrganOx, engaging confidently with external stakeholders including regulatory bodies, partners, and customers.


This is an on\-site role in Oxford with flexibility.


Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

**Major Responsibilities**

Under direction from the Director, Embedded Software Development, the Windows Software Manager will be responsible for:

**Resource management**

* Lead and manage a team of Windows software engineers, fostering a high\-performance culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
* Providing line management, including goal setting, performance reviews, development planning, and ongoing coaching.
* Mentor and support engineers in low\-level design, debugging, and real\-time system development challenges.
* Define and maintain an effective team structure, including roles, responsibilities, operating mechanisms, and supporting infrastructure.
* Plan and manage resource allocation, including headcount planning, role definition, workload distribution, and optimisation of team utilisation across distributed teams.
* Oversee recruitment activities, including identifying hiring needs, interviewing, candidate evaluation, hiring recommendations, onboarding, and probation management.
* Maintain visibility of team capabilities (knowledge, skills, and abilities) and develop targeted training and development plans to address gaps and enhance performance.
* Facilitate clear and effective communication within the team and across stakeholders, ensuring alignment with wider organisational objectives.

**Planning**

* Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
* Guide technical decisions, design reviews.
* Ensure robust software integration with cross\-functional teams
* Drive Agile or hybrid Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Author and execute a roadmap of developments to improve the Software Engineering function, with emphasis on application\-level software.
* Financial forecasting and spend tracking against approved department and project budgets.


**Technical Oversight \& Execution**

* Provide technical leadership for the development of application\-level software for Class II and Class III medical devices.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, including requirements definition, architecture, implementation, testing, and maintenance.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory standards and frameworks, including FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and other relevant safety standards.
* Establish and enforce high\-quality software engineering practices, including code reviews, architectural governance, and design best practices.
* Contribute hands\-on expertise in complex or critical technical areas when required.
* Drive design principles that support modularity, testability, maintainability, scalability.
* Oversee release quality, defect management, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Process and tools**

* SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and Work Instructions supporting Software Engineering.
* Selection, development, and qualification of Software Engineering tools and systems.

**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Data powers every package we deliver—and as our Engineering Manager, you’ll power the team behind it.**


At Instabee, our Data Platform team is at the heart of how we make faster, smarter decisions, from lead times and locker performance to merchant checkout analytics. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, someone who's ready to grow people, scope projects and shape deliveries, and manage stakeholders with ease.


You should understand the product roadmap well enough to contribute to it, be comfortable facilitating discussions and unblocking the team, and bring enough high tech fluency to support the team when it's needed. You'll join our EM crew and work closely with your team's Product Manager, Staff Engineer, and business stakeholders across the company.

**Some of the things you'll do:**

* Lead a small, sharp team of engineers. 1:1s, coaching, hiring, and performance, all on you
* Continue build a team culture where psychological safety isn't a buzzword, it's the baseline
* Build a strong partnership with your Product Manager and Staff Engineer to clearly advocate for the team’s roadmap and constraints, while effectively bridging communication with Engineering Directors and Business Leads
* Help the team break down messy, ambiguous problems into concrete next steps
* Own delivery and team health in a lean setup. No safety net of extra support layers beneath you
* Help shape a strong EM culture by sharing what you learn (and stealing what works from others)

##### **Your future team**


The Data Platform team is a central team building a modern data platform on GCP and Snowflake for delivering core data products and metrics to the whole organization. It is pulling in data from everywhere, and owning everything from CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code to pipeline orchestration. The work is technical, high\-impact, and essential to whether the rest of the business can actually trust its data.

##### **What we're looking for**


We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys leading people and isn't afraid to dive into the messy parts of building a team.

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* **A coaching mindset and passion for team dynamics:** You are genuinely energized by growing people, building trust, and shaping high\-performing teams.
* **The courage to guide through change:** You have the guts to hold hard conversations when necessary and steer the team through organizational shifts.
* **Adaptive leadership:** The instinct to know when to lead versus when to manage, and the wisdom to tell the difference.
* **Scoping, prioritizing, and planning:** Proven ability to break apart complex projects into clear, actionable steps and realistic goals.
* **Ways of Working \& unblocking:** Expertise in agile practices, facilitating technical discussions, and clearing roadblocks to keep the team moving forward.
* **Clear stakeholder communication:** Strong expectation management skills across business leads and directors..
* **High\-level technical fluency:** Enough tech background (e.g., modern data platforms, infrastructure) to earn respect, understand context, and support the team where needed.
* **Product roadmap alignment:** Experience contributing directly to product strategy to advocate for the team’s roadmap.
* **Language skills:** Spoken or written Swedish is a plus, though English is our daily working language.

##### **What you'll get**


We can promise you'll be challenged, grow fast, and work alongside genuinely excellent people. If you like shaking things up and building new ways of working from scratch — this is your place.

**Beyond the usual essentials, we've also got:**


**Six months' parental pay:** Step away and give your little one everything they need


**A day off on your birthday:** Because you deserve to celebrate properly

**Hybrid \& Flexible:** Work the way that works for you


Diversity and inclusion matter deeply to us, and we're committed to building a workplace where every perspective is valued and everyone has room to grow.

**If leading through change, growing great engineers, and turning complex challenges into clear paths forward sounds like your kind of work, we’d love to hear from you!**

**Note on our process:** *As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*

jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer  



This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



**Senior Backend Engineer**

**Location:** Galway Ireland

**Type:** Permanent Full time

 **Summary**


We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer focused on delivering high\-quality architecture, design, and robust code.  

In this role, you'll work with your team to tackle the hardest programming, performance, and reliability challenges, collaborating on design reviews and technical decisions. You'll leverage AI tools to streamline development and improve efficiency.


Your contributions will have visible impact on our core product—improving time\-to\-market and satisfying current and future customer needs.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

**Technical Design \& Development**

* Design and develop cutting\-edge system software products.
* Drive performance optimization and efficient memory management.
* Develop innovative solutions addressing challenges in virtualization, multithreading, and hardware–software interaction.
* Design and implement robust, scalable solutions for complex challenges.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks in system design and implement scalable solutions.
* Perform in\-depth debugging, triaging, and resolution for a variety of issues.

**Collaboration \& Innovation**

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align on design goals and ensure seamless integration with the system architecture.
* Explore and implement new methodologies fostering continuous improvement and innovation.
* Stay updated on evolving trends in virtualization technologies to bring innovative practices to the team.
* Exhibit flexibility in taking on new or related tasks, showcasing adaptability and a proactive, problem\-solving mindset.

 **Knowledge and Skills**

* In\-depth working knowledge and hands\-on backend experience.
* At least 7 years of expertise in C\#.
* AI adopter with proven hands\-on experience applying generative AI tools to streamline software development, improve engineering efficiency, and support a continuous\-learning mindset.
* Strong knowledge of Linux and virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper\-V, KVM, and OpenShift.
* Deep expertise in software systems design, development methodologies, and integration across diverse platforms and technologies.
* Strong ability to innovate and bring fresh approaches to technical challenges.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with a proactive mindset and sharp analytical abilities.
* Exceptional communication skills to effectively present and discuss technical designs, proposals, and solutions with senior management and stakeholders.
* Ability to work autonomously.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of backend experience.
* Hands\-on experience applying generative AI tools to streamline software development

**Accessibility**

  

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

  

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health \& Wellbeing**


We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

**Personal \& Professional Development**


We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

**Unconditional Inclusion**


We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

**Let's Stay Connected:**


Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Job Purpose:
**About RWS**  

RWS is a global AI solutions company empowering the world’s most trusted enterprise AI.  

Our proprietary Cultural Intelligence Layer, powered by 250,000 data specialists, cultural and language experts and deep domain professionals, backed by 45\+ patents, makes enterprise AI culturally fluent, contextually accurate and secure, ensuring every interaction reflects a brand’s tone, context and customer values.  

Through our Generate, Transform and Protect segments, we deliver intelligent content, enterprise knowledge, large\-scale localization and IP protection for global growth. Trusted by 80\+ of the world’s top 100 brands, RWS provides the confidence, governance and expertise organizations need to deploy AI safely, responsibly and at scale.  

Headquartered in the UK, RWS is listed on AIM (RWS.L).
More information: rws.com. **About Propylon**  

  

Propylon is the Dublin\-based content‑management arm within the RWS group, specialising in software for legal and regulatory workflows. For more than 20 years, Propylon has helped governments, standard bodies and regulated organisations manage legislation, regulations and legal content in a smarter, modular way.  

Joining Propylon means working in a people\-led, innovation\-driven environment recognised as one of Ireland’s Best Workplaces in Tech \- while having the backbone and global reach of RWS. You’d be contributing to meaningful projects that shape law, compliance and global content workflows, with the support and flexibility to grow your skills and career.

* Work with a highly skilled engineering team who are experts in their field
* Design and implement new features for Propylon’s core product suite
* Build in\-depth experience with Python, JavaScript, and C\#
* Work on exciting data challenges such as NLP, topic discovery, similarity detection and more

* Attending daily team standups
* Participating in the code review process
* Writing software for our core product suite
* Working alongside senior engineers, software architects, and team leads to solve problems for our clients and implement new product features

* A love for technology
* Confidence in taking on large projects and initiatives
* Some experience in Linux\-based systems
* Ideally, prior experience with one of the following: Python, C\#, or JavaScript
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Experience with machine learning would be a plus

This role is based in our Dublin office, in Rathfarnham, South Dublin, though we operate a very flexible hybrid model which facilitates regular home\-working. This is an exciting opportunity to join JPMorgan, this role is a **Jobshare** (part\-time hours where 2 people share the responsibility of the role) if this is the flexibility you need this could be the role for you.

**This is Jobshare/ Part\-time role \- Schedule required is \- 18hrs \- Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday \& Friday either working AM/PM there is flexibility on these days \& hours**


We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.


As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within CIB, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way.


You are responsible for delivering critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions, in support of the firm's business objectives.

**Job responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
* Creates secure, high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met through software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
* Contributes to software engineering communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies
* Contributes to a team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect
* Formal training/certification in Software Engineering (or equivalent experience) with 3\+ years of applied, hands\-on development experience.
* Hands\-on experience across system design, application development, automated testing, and production support, with a focus on operational stability (monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root\-cause analysis).
* Proficiency in one or more modern object\-oriented, compiled languages (e.g., Java, C\#, C\+\+, Go, Rust) and the ability to write clean, maintainable, well\-structured code.
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment using one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies and practices such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
* Demonstrated knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)

* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training/certification in Software Engineering (or equivalent experience) with 3\+ years of applied, hands\-on development experience.
* Hands\-on experience across system design, application development, automated testing, and production support, with a focus on operational stability (monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root\-cause analysis).
* Proficiency in one or more modern object\-oriented, compiled languages (e.g., Java, C\#, C\+\+, Go, Rust) and the ability to write clean, maintainable, well\-structured code.
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment using one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies and practices such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
* Demonstrated knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
* AI\-enabled productivity: Demonstrated ability to use AI/LLM tools responsibly to improve day\-to\-day engineering work while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and usage guidelines.
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies
* Familiarity with Java Spring Boot services.
* Exposure to cloud technologies

jobs.title: Data Centre Commissioning Engineer – Process Water Treatment
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**


The Commissioning Engineer will lead the commissioning, testing, optimisation and handover of advanced process water treatment systems within hyperscale and enterprise data centre environments. This role ensures that all mechanical, electrical, control and process\-treatment systems operate safely, efficiently and in accordance with project specifications, industry standards and client requirements.


The ideal candidate has strong technical expertise in water treatment processes, instrumentation and control systems and thrives in fastpaced, highreliability sectors such as missioncritical data centre operations.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

**Commissioning \& Testing**

* Plan, execute, and document commissioning activities for water treatment systems (e.g., filtration, softening, RO, UF, chemical dosing, polishing).
* Conduct functional testing, FAT/SAT support, equipment startup, performance testing, and process optimisation.
* Verify operation of pumps, valves, skids, chemical handling systems, controls and treatment stages.
* Ensure all systems comply with project specifications, HSE requirements and relevant standards.

**Data Centre Systems Integration**

* Coordinate commissioning activities with mechanical, electrical, and BMS/SCADA teams within data centre environments.
* Validate water quality and system performance to meet cooling, humidification and process\-water requirements.
* Troubleshoot system interactions related to cooling towers, adiabatic systems, closed\-loop circuits, and humidity control.

**Technical Documentation \& Reporting**

* Develop commissioning plans, method statements, risk assessments and testing protocols.
* Produce detailed commissioning reports, performance summaries and O\&M documentation.
* Maintain accurate logs of test results, deviations, punch\-list items and rectification plans.

**Client \& Stakeholder Coordination**

* Work closely with project managers, design engineers, contractors and client FM/operations teams.
* Participate in technical meetings, design reviews and handover discussions.
* Provide technical support and training to client operations teams during transition to steady\-state operations.

**Quality, Safety \& Compliance**

* Ensure all commissioning activities follow safety legislation, environmental guidelines and internal quality systems.
* Identify design or installation issues and propose/implement corrective actions.
* Champion safe work practices within highrisk, missioncritical environments.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of water treatment technologies (e.g., RO, UF, ion exchange, chemical dosing, disinfection, filtration).
* Experience with instrumentation, control systems, PLCs, and BMS/SCADA interfaces.
* Understanding of mechanical and electrical systems in industrial or missioncritical facilities.

**Experience**

* Previous commissioning or process engineering experience in water treatment, industrial utilities, or data centre sectors.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot mechanical, process and control system issues.

**Qualifications**

* Degree/HND in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications (e.g., IOSH/NEBOSH, water treatment qualifications) beneficial.

**Behavioural Skills**

* Strong problem\-solving ability and technical curiosity.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Flexible, selfdriven and capable of working independently or within multi\-disciplinary teams.

 **Desirable Experience (Optional):**

* Commissioning in hyperscale cloud provider facilities (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google).
* Experience with highpurity or ultrapure water systems.
* Familiarity with data centre cooling systems and redundancy models (N, N\+1, 2N).
* Knowledge of environmental compliance related to water discharge and chemical handling.

 **Working Conditions:**

* Site\-based or hybrid role depending on project phase.
* May require travel to national or international project sites.
* Work in construction, live data centre, and plant\-room environments.

 **Compensation Package:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth
* CPD accredited employer
* A collaborative and supportive work environment
* Laptop or desktop and work mobile phone provided
* Flexible working options, dependent on location and role requirements
* See company website for more information on the benefits of working in EPS Group

  

We welcome speculative applications from individuals of all levels.

**If you have any questions about this role or would like further information, please contact our recruiting team by emailing jobs@epswater.com.**

*Since 1968, we have grown from a modest electrical and pumping services business and developed into an innovative, internationally exporting product and service provider, now focused upon the water, wastewater and clean technology sectors, operating across the Republic of Ireland, the UK and Northern Europe.*

*We are an international water infrastructure specialist, one of the few genuine end\-to\-end service providers in the global water sector, providing large scale employment, bringing market leading and ground breaking technologies to Ireland and working to improve the country's water infrastructure.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer C++ - Bergen
jobs.description:
Since 1997, Vizrt has empowered the world’s leading broadcasters and content creators – Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, CNN, BBC, Fox, CBS, Al Jazeera, and 100\+ others – with cutting\-edge visual storytelling technology. We’re a global team of 600\+ innovators across 17 countries, pushing the boundaries of graphics control, real\-time graphics, cloud production, and broadcast automation.


Our office is located in Media City Bergen, Norway. You will work alongside international colleagues in an environment where team spirit and work\-life balance are taken seriously. Read more at www.vizrt.com/vizrt


You will join the team responsible for developing high\-performance video processing components used across several of Vizrt’s products, including our real\-time graphics, sports analysis, and media asset management solutions. The team works on core technology for processing, transcoding, and handling professional video in demanding production environments.


As a senior engineer, you will work hands\-on with modern C\+\+ to develop and evolve these components. You will solve challenging technical problems involving performance, reliability, and efficient processing of video and media, while contributing to the architecture and long\-term direction of the technology.


You will be part of a broader backend engineering environment responsible for several of Vizrt’s core technologies. Depending on product priorities and your interests, there may also be opportunities to contribute to other backend components, including the Vizrt Media Sequencer, a core platform used to control graphics, video, and other media in live production workflows.


We are looking for engineers who enjoy understanding complex systems, solving difficult technical problems, and building reliable software that operates in performance\-critical environments.


You will identify bottlenecks and bugs, design and implement new functionality, and help improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our software. You will work closely with experienced colleagues across multiple countries and teams, and your contributions will directly affect products used by broadcasters and content creators around the world.


For candidates interested in broader responsibility, there are opportunities to contribute to technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural decision\-making.

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent skills and experience
* Software engineering experience with modern C\+\+
* Experience with Python and/or C\#, or interest in working with the languages
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience troubleshooting, profiling, and improving complex software systems
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles and best practices
* Experience with automated testing
* Experience collaborating across teams, mentoring colleagues, or contributing to technical decision\-making
* Fluency in written and spoken English
* Good communication and team\-working skills
* Experience with video processing, video codecs, transcoding, or multimedia frameworks is an advantage, but not a requirement.

  

**Benefits**  

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Private health insurance, a competitive pension scheme
* Paid Time Off: Generous vacation days, sick leave, and public holidays to support a healthy work–life balance
* Professional Development: Opportunities for ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities
* Innovation Days (three per month) dedicated to experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement
* Modern office located in Media City Bergen


Join our team and take advantage of these benefits while working in a dynamic and supportive environment.

* Team Interview
* Case Interview

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Developer**
=============================

Date: Sep 17, 2026
Location:
Copenhagen, DK
Company: Getinge IT Solutions ApS
Remote Work: 1\-2 days at home (site based)  

**With a passion for life**

  

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life\-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.


Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

  

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build\-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.  

  

  



Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.  

  

  



**What you would be building**


Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.


Our software is mission\-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.  

  

  



**What we work with**


Our teams work primarily in C\#/.Net \&Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real\-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.


We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.  

  

  



**Where we are with AI**


We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI\-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.


If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.


Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

  

**What you will do**


* Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission\-critical hospital software.
* Build and integrate **agentic AI** capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM\-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
* Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
* Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.

Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.  
* 

**You will bring**


* **Strong .NET expertise** – deep, hands\-on experience building and maintaining production software in C\# and modern .NET.
* **Breadth and adaptability** – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
* **Real depth with AI in practice** – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands\-on with agents and LLM\-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
* **A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset** – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.

The ability to build maintainable, high\-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.  
* 

**Nice to have**


* Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
* Experience with event\-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.

Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety\-critical products.  
* 

**What we offer**


Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.


* A smart working environment with shared desks, several work\-from\-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
* Flexible working hours.
* Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
* Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.
  

**Application**
Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17\-10\-2026


We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e\-mail.

  

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com  

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company. \#LI\-JM2  

**About us**

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.


Our software is mission\-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.  

  

  



**What we work with**


Our teams work primarily in C\#/.Net \&Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real\-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.


We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.  

  

  



**Where we are with AI**


We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI\-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.


If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.


Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

  

**What you will do**


* Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission\-critical hospital software.
* Build and integrate **agentic AI** capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM\-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
* Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
* Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.

Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.  
* 

**You will bring**


* **Strong .NET expertise** – deep, hands\-on experience building and maintaining production software in C\# and modern .NET.
* **Breadth and adaptability** – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
* **Real depth with AI in practice** – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands\-on with agents and LLM\-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
* **A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset** – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.

The ability to build maintainable, high\-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.  
* 

**Nice to have**


* Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
* Experience with event\-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.

Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety\-critical products.  
* 

**What we offer**


Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.


* A smart working environment with shared desks, several work\-from\-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
* Flexible working hours.
* Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
* Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.
  

**Application**
Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17\-10\-2026


We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e\-mail.

  

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com  

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company. \#LI\-JM2  

**About us**

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Workato**
=================



Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.


**Why join us?**
================



Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company.



But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That's why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.



If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!



Also, feel free to check out why:


* Business Insider named us an "enterprise startup to bet your career on"
* Forbes' Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers
**Responsibilities**
====================



We're building the infrastructure layer that connects enterprise systems to AI: an **MCP Gateway**, an **AI Gateway**, and the services around them. These are the systems that sit between LLM providers and everything else — routing, auth, rate limiting, observability, protocol translation. We're looking for a senior engineer who understands both the systems layer and the AI protocol layer, and who can build production\-grade services in Go and/or Ruby.



In this role, you will also be responsible to:


* **Design and develop the MCP Gateway and AI Gateway** — production services that mediate between applications, AI agents, and LLM providers. This means protocol\-level work: MCP server/client implementations, request routing, streaming, tool\-call proxying, authn/authz, and tenant isolation. You'll build the core infrastructure, not just applications on top of it.
* **Build high\-throughput, low\-latency network services.** You'll work close to the wire: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1\.1 and HTTP/2, JSON streaming, connection pooling, backpressure. When latency matters, you'll know exactly where it goes.
* **Own the data layer from the application side.** Deep PostgreSQL knowledge — schema design, indexing strategies, query planning, transactions and isolation levels, connection management. You're not a DBA, but you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and fix the query, not just add an index and hope.
* **Design for concurrency.** Worker pools, queues, graceful shutdown, backpressure, race\-free shared state. You can profile a service under load (pprof, flamegraphs, query stats), find the bottleneck, and fix it.
* **Drive observability for AI systems.** Metrics, tracing, and logging that actually tell you what's happening — token usage, latency per provider, cache hit rates, failure modes, cost per request.

### **How we work with AI**


* **We encourage — but never force — the use of AI/LLM tools in development.** If AI\-assisted workflows make you faster, use them heavily. If you prefer to write something by hand, that's equally respected. What we care about is the quality of what ships, not how it was typed.
* **You'll have access to nearly every major tool and model on the market** — coding agents, IDEs, frontier models — with very generous usage limits. We want tooling budget to never be the reason a good idea goes unexplored.
* **We actively explore and enhance automated development.** You'll help shape how the team uses AI: agent workflows, code review automation, internal tooling. We build AI infrastructure, so we hold ourselves to being its most sophisticated users.
* **We believe LLM tools give a single engineer full visibility across the product**, regardless of area — frontend, backend, infra, docs. We want people who use that leverage to own problems end\-to\-end rather than stay inside one layer.
* **But the accountability never shifts to the machine.** You own what you merge. You can explain every statement and decision in the final output, and justify and defend the architectural choices to human colleagues in design and code reviews. "The AI suggested it" is never an acceptable rationale.

**Requirements**
================


### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills**


* **Senior\-level experience (5\+ years) in Go, Ruby, or both.** Any combination works: deep Go, deep Ruby, or strong in both. What matters is that you've shipped and operated production services in at least one of them.
* **Go candidates:** you know the stdlib deeply and prefer it over frameworks. net/http, crypto/tls, context, goroutines and channels, the memory model. You've done performance optimization on real services — allocations, GC pressure, lock contention — and you understand networking (TCP, TLS, HTTP, JSON) in depth, not just through a framework's abstraction.
* **Ruby candidates:** strong Rails in production — you know where Rails ends and Ruby begins, you've tuned ActiveRecord rather than fought it, and you've built services that stay fast under load.
* **PostgreSQL depth from an application developer's perspective.** Query optimization, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, migrations at scale. You don't need to administer the cluster; you need to write code that treats it well.
* **Concurrency and profiling as a practiced skill**, not a bullet point. You've debugged a production incident with a profiler open.
* **Familiarity with Kubernetes and containers.** You can deploy, debug, and reason about your services in a containerized environment — resource limits, health checks, rolling deploys, networking basics.
* You've built production services with proper observability, deployment pipelines, and security. You know how to run reliable systems and debug distributed systems when things break.

### **AI/LLM Experience**


* You've worked with LLMs at the **protocol level** — message structures, tool calling, streaming responses, caching strategies. You know what's happening on the wire, not just what the SDK abstracts away.
* Familiarity with **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** is a strong plus — ideally you've built or integrated MCP servers/clients and understand the transport and capability negotiation layers.
* You can integrate with OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic APIs directly, evaluate responses, understand token usage, and optimize for latency and cost.
* **You can judge, audit, and verify LLM output.** You catch subtle bugs, security issues, and hallucinated APIs before they ship — and you're fluent enough in the underlying systems to know *why* the output is wrong, not just *that* it's wrong.

### **Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics**


* You learn fast and stay current. AI infrastructure is moving weekly; you follow it and can evaluate new protocols and approaches quickly.
* You participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike.
* You're comfortable owning the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
